passages.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: The LORD is good.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.\r\nGive thanks to the LORD.
passages.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
passages.sermon:
Israel is God’s chosen people.
God’s loving devotion lasts forever.
Let Israel say this truth.
God’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: יֹֽאמַר־ נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
passages.sermon: The house of Aaron is the family of priests in Israel.\r\nLet the house of Aaron speak.\r\nGod’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: יֹֽאמְרוּ־ נָ֥א בֵֽית־ אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
passages.sermon: Those who fear the LORD must speak.\r\nThey must say this truth.\r\nGod’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: יֹֽאמְרוּ־ נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
passages.sermon:
I felt distress.
I called to the LORD.
The LORD answered me.
The LORD set me free.
passages.original: מִֽן־ הַ֭מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ׃

passages.text: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is with me.
He stands by my side.
I will not be afraid.
No person can harm me.
No one can do anything to me.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־ יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
passages.sermon: The LORD is with me.\r\nThe LORD helps me.\r\nI will see victory over those who hate me.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃

passages.text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is a safe place.
He protects people who come to Him.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD.
Do not trust in man instead of God.
Trusting in the LORD is better than trusting in people.
passages.original: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם׃

passages.text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful and trustworthy.
Princes are human leaders.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD.
Do not trust in princes instead of God.
Trusting the LORD is safer than relying on princes.
passages.original: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים׃

passages.text: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
passages.sermon:
All the nations surrounded me.
I stood alone against them.
I called on the name of the LORD.
The LORD gave me strength.
I defeated all the nations.
passages.original: כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

passages.text: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
passages.sermon:
Enemies surrounded me.
They were on every side.
I called on the LORD.
I used the LORD’s name.
I cut off my enemies.
passages.original: סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם־ סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

passages.text: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
passages.sermon:
Many enemies surrounded me.
They came at me from all sides.
They swarmed around me like bees.
They attacked together.
But they did not last.
They burned out quickly, like thorns in a fire.
I called on the LORD.
I trusted in His name.
In the name of the LORD, I cut off my enemies.
God gave me victory.
passages.original: סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

passages.text: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
passages.sermon: Enemies pushed me very hard.\r\nI began to fall.\r\nThe LORD helped me.
passages.original: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃

passages.text: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
passages.sermon: The LORD is my strength.\r\nThe LORD is my song.\r\nThe LORD has become my salvation.
passages.original: עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־ לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃

passages.text: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
passages.sermon:
The righteous live in tents.
Joy fills their tents.
Salvation fills their tents.
People shout with joy in these tents.
The LORD acts with great power.
The right hand of the LORD does mighty things.
passages.original: ק֤וֹל׀ רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃

passages.text: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
His right hand is lifted high.
His right hand is strong.
The LORD acts with great strength.
The LORD does mighty deeds.
passages.original: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃

passages.text: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a righteous person.
The LORD has preserved this person’s life.
This person will not die.
This person will live.
This person will proclaim what the LORD has done.
passages.original: לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי־ אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ׃

passages.text: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
passages.sermon: The LORD disciplined me.\r\nThe LORD disciplined me severely.\r\nThe LORD did not give me over to death.
passages.original: יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי׃

passages.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker asks for the gates of righteousness to open.
The speaker wants to enter through these gates.
The speaker will give thanks to the LORD.
passages.original: פִּתְחוּ־ לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי־ צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא־ בָ֝ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ׃

passages.text: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy and just.
This is His gate.
The gate belongs to the LORD.
Righteous people will enter through this gate.
Only the righteous may go in.
passages.original: זֶֽה־ הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker gives thanks to the LORD.
The LORD answered the speaker.
The LORD became the speaker’s salvation.
passages.original: א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי־ לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃

passages.text: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
passages.sermon:
The builders rejected a stone.
This stone became the cornerstone.
God made the rejected stone most important.
The cornerstone now supports everything else.
passages.original: אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה׃

passages.text: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
passages.sermon:
The LORD has done this.
This comes from the LORD.
We see it.
It amazes us.
It is wonderful to us.
passages.original: מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He made this day.
We will rejoice in this day.
We will be glad in this day.
passages.original: זֶה־ הַ֭יּוֹם עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃

passages.text: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
We pray to the LORD.
We ask the LORD to save us.
We ask the LORD to help us succeed.
We call on the LORD for deliverance.
We call on the LORD for prosperity.
passages.original: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא׃

passages.text: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He sends people in His name.
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD.
We bless you from the house of the LORD.
passages.original: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַֽכְנוּכֶ֗ם מִבֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD shines His light on us.
Bind the festival sacrifice with cords.
Tie it to the horns of the altar.
passages.original: אֵ֤ל׀ יְהוָה֮ וַיָּ֪אֶר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ־ חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד־ קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
passages.sermon:
God, you are my God.
I give you thanks.
You are my God.
I exalt you.
passages.original: אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ׃

passages.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is good.
His loving devotion lasts forever.
Give thanks to the LORD.
passages.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
